Lily's favorite animal is the rabbit. Lily learned a lot about art. Life is full of small surprises. A big crowd waited at the gate.
Lily is going to travel to Rome in May. Lily hopes to visit Rome one day. They took many photos at the ticket office. The flight was delayed by heavy rain.
The old town is one of the best places in the city. Lily wrote about the day in the diary. It takes twenty minutes to get to the old town by bike. Also, maps are free at the visitor centre.
Lily spent the weekend at the gym. Both of them like fish and juice. The weather was rainy that day.
